historySource.indexText: The battle fought here on March 15, 1781, opened the campaign that led to American victory in the Revolutionary War. The British lost a substantial number of troops at the battle, a factor in their surrender at Yorktown seven months later. Established March 2, 1917; transferred from War Dept. Aug. 10, 1933.
